title: Bookings show on the Space calendar and reach a connected Google calendar, and Google busy time stays fresh

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-21: nothing in lib/calendar or lib/calendar-sync reads space_bookings, so an owner's calendar console (the place they plan their week) never shows a booking, and sync never pushes one out. Busy time from Google blocks bookings, but only after a manual Sync now (no cron), so stale busy data lets a booking land on an outside meeting. Calendar sync itself is not live: its migration is unapplied and the Google credentials are owed (LIVE-1179, docs/RUNBOOKS.md Calendar sync). Fix: a bookings layer in the calendar registry, push bookings as events through the existing sync, and a short-interval busy refresh for connected Spaces.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
